title: verbs for actions
rule: Lead with a verb (or a specific verb phrase) for commands that initiate an action or submit information; prefer a specific verb over a generic Next.
pass_when: Action/submit commands lead with a verb or specific verb phrase, not a generic Next.
fail_when: Noun-only or generic Next where a specific verb is available.
overview: Action and submit commands lead with a specific verb, not generic Next.
apply_when: Labeling commands that initiate work or submit information.
not_when: Appearance adjectives for look/state toggles rather than actions.
agent_hint: Lead action/submit labels with a specific verb; avoid noun-only or Next.
description: Commands that initiate an action or submit information should lead with a verb or specific verb phrase. Prefer a concrete verb over a generic Next when a better word exists for the outcome. Noun-only labels and vague Next hide what will happen after the click. Keep adjectives for appearance commands; verbs own the action and submit lane.
